newsitem.title: USA: Oregon bond panel okays affordable housing bonds.
newsitem.headline: Oregon bond panel okays affordable housing bonds.

text.p: An Oregon bond committee allocated more than $26 million to finance affordable housing projects in the state, Oregon Treasurer Jim Hill said Friday.
The funds will be issued as tax-exempt bonds to provide low-cost financing for low and moderate income families and first-time home buyers at or below the median income, he said.

Oregon's Private Activity Bond Committee approved bonding authority for the Cedarwest Apartments Project in Bend, the Civic Stadium Housing Project in Portland and the Oregon Housing and Community Services Department, Hill said.
The Private Activity Bond Committee, which includes a representative of the state treasurer, is responsible for approving the issuance of private activity bonds.
Each year the state of Oregon has $150 million of private activity bonds to allocate, Hill said in a statement.
